== Editing ==
Shared English Decipher-era comparison for [[Corellia]]. The 1998 Glossary replacement is distinct from the later PC text or uniqueness change. Only source-backed state columns belong here; Revised, Japanese, foil and Virtual articles remain in Versions. A blank stamp cell means the cited text document does not establish a printed stamp. Image dimensions do not identify Errata. Use {{tl|Errata hl}} only for changed text or values.
